scope: research/pq-wkem only; statement-aware Boolean-vanishing correlated noise plus public bounded-zonotope complete-output audit
proved_claims: For Y=K u+G r+N eta with N drawn from public Boolean-vanishing polynomial generators, every valid Boolean witness recovers K exactly, while each fixed invalid Boolean assignment has an exactly uniform constraint-mask phase.
On every true statement, u is outside the public mask span W=colspan(G,N), so Gaussian elimination computes lambda with lambda^T W=0 and lambda^T u=1, giving lambda^T Y=K with no source witness.

If the public dual affine space has dimension d, a uniformly sampled dual is a Boolean evaluation vector with probability at most 2^n/q^d; the attacker can test and reject evaluation vectors without solving the source instance.

There exists an explicit unsatisfiable four-variable nine-clause fixture in the degree-4 feature space for which every Boolean candidate has perfect marginal hiding but rank(W)=37, rank([W,u])=38, so the complete public vector reveals K.

For public bounded zonotope noise H xi with ||xi||_infinity<=B, the public LP minimizing ||H^T lambda||_1 over all exact-mask annihilators has worst-case support radius no larger than every legitimate witness evaluation.
not_claimed: No impossibility result for hidden nonlinear noise geometry.
No theorem for arbitrary high-probability distributional decoding metrics beyond the stated deterministic support-radius model.
No generic modular-wraparound short-dual impossibility theorem.
No break of LWE or SIS.
No arbitrary-QPT final-key recovery to source-witness reduction.
No completed generic PQ witness KEM.
Tests are not a security proof.
